images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one square transparent-background spot illustration for a Japanese camper battery website, displayed at about 110 pixels wide beside two other related illustrations.
Style: hand-drawn Japanese editorial manga, fine slightly irregular charcoal ink outlines, simple flat muted colors, sparse light hatching. Restrained ordinary proportions, absolutely not glossy 3D, not photorealistic, not cute toy clip art.
Vehicle design: a cream Japanese cab-over motorhome, compact truck cab, over-cab sleeping compartment with one small rectangular window, olive green horizontal stripe along body, dark tires, gray bumper, simple realistic windows. No manufacturer logos.
Palette: cream, olive green, warm brown, charcoal, small amber accents. The illustration sits on a deep forest-green webpage; silhouettes must read clearly.
Composition: entire scene fully contained in a centered square with a small 6% breathing margin. Simplify detail enough to remain readable at thumbnail size. Transparent negative space around all objects, no square backdrop, no border, no text, no labels, no typography, no watermarks. One standalone illustration, not a collage or a multi-panel sheet.
Scene: the motorhome is DRIVING along a short curved gray country road, viewed from the front-left three-quarter angle, front facing left. The motorhome fills most of the picture. Two small hand-drawn motion strokes behind the rear wheel communicate forward travel. A tiny understated silhouette of an ordinary adult male driver through the windshield. A minimal patch of grass and a single small roadside shrub frame the road; no landscape or sky background. Grounded full-scale vehicle proportions and visible rolling wheels, no electric charging cable. Warm daylight. Main message: charging during travel.

A simple cropped portion of a beige Japanese house with a brown gabled roof sits behind it on the right, enough to instantly communicate HOME. An amber-orange shore-power cable is clearly visible, running from a weatherproof outlet on the home's exterior wall down toward the ground and gently curving to the motorhome's side-mounted shore-power inlet behind the cab. This is external power for the motorhome habitation battery, not an EV charging station. Keep the cable short, visible and physically plausible. No person, no carport, no garage door, no extra car. A small patch of driveway anchors objects; all surroundings transparent. Main message: charging from household external power.

review: Three original cream/olive motorhome spot illustrations: driving on road, home shore-power cable, rooftop solar panels under sunlight. Generated transparent alpha preserved; no labels or logos in artwork.
